def build_model():
    import cadquery as cq
    torso = cq.Workplane("XY").box(24, 16, 70, centered=(True, True, False)).translate((0, 0, 22))
    head = cq.Workplane("XY").box(18, 16, 18, centered=(True, True, False)).translate((0, 0, 90))
    left_arm = cq.Workplane("XY").box(10, 12, 46, centered=(True, True, False)).translate((-17, 0, 40))
    right_arm = cq.Workplane("XY").box(10, 12, 46, centered=(True, True, False)).translate((17, 0, 40))
    left_leg = cq.Workplane("XY").box(9, 12, 36, centered=(True, True, False)).translate((-7, 0, 0))
    right_leg = cq.Workplane("XY").box(9, 12, 36, centered=(True, True, False)).translate((7, 0, 0))
    model = torso.union(head).union(left_arm).union(right_arm).union(left_leg).union(right_leg)
    return model
